name: Epilepsy Foundation New England Sailing Camp
street_address: Sail to Prevail docks, Fort Adams State Park
description_short: A short day sailing camp run by Epilepsy Foundation New England with Sail To Prevail, whose adapted 20 foot boats let sailors with disabilities steer and trim on Narragansett Bay.
special_needs_notes: Part of Epilepsy Foundation New England's Purple Camp programs, hosted by Sail To Prevail, which sails specially adapted boats with people with disabilities. Parents or guardians give any medications.
notes: Runs 11:00 am to 3:00 pm. Application deadline was July 1, 2026. Limited spots.

for_andrew: The page calls it a weekend long day camp but lists August 3 to 7, 2026 (Monday to Friday), 11 am to 3 pm. I used the listed dates.
zip 02840 comes from Sail To Prevail's Newport page (the host), not the Epilepsy Foundation page.
Sail To Prevail itself is a separate draft (sail-to-prevail-newport, marked drop). This is a different program (a camp week run by Epilepsy Foundation New England), so I kept it separate.
